summary: About to: the future marker of Classical Chinese, and in 將來 a modern word for the future. Read jiàng, it is a general.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Lorenz-84 trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 望 takes the highest point, gazing up; 劫 the point farthest from the rest, at the edge of the eon. A design choice, not a claim.

satellites.title: Not Knowing Old Age Is Coming
satellites.evidence: Analects 7.19: Confucius would have himself described as one who 發憤忘食，樂以忘憂，不知老之將至 — “forgets to eat in his zeal, forgets his cares in his joy, and does not know that old age is about to arrive.” 將 marks what is on its way.
